metadataRaw.title: How to Fix Your Hip Pain | STEP-BY-STEP Guide
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly relieve hip pain with an easy to follow step-by-step guide. 

We're going to make getting relief easy by focusing on the main cause of hip pain, which is weakness and tightness in the muscles that support the hips. This includes the glutes (buttocks), psoas (hip flexors), and piriformis muscles.  

Also, we'll focus on improving hip mobility to help relieve symptoms caused from hip osteoarthritis (wear-and tear arthritis). 

As a bonus, all of the exercises can be done at home, require no equipment, and may give hip pain relief within 30 seconds.

Watch now and fix your hip pain for good! 

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:05 Muscle Warm Up
3:10 Hip Flexors and Core Strengthening 
5:37 Back, Glutes, and Legs Strengthening 
8:49 Hip Flexor Stretching 
11:33 Glutes Stretching
